findings: Owner request 2026-11-09: practice short questions for Chapter 7 in the same format as the Physics chapter practice, long questions in the Computer Science Board shape (8 marks each) (English and Roman Urdu), written from the chapter; not printed in the book. 66 questions numbered 1-66; by section: u-introduction 1, 7.1 1, u-meaning-of-hypothesis 2, u-research-questions-and-hypotheses 2, u-role-of-hypothesis-testing-in-data-analysis 2, 7.2 1, u-null-hypothesis-h0 2, u-alternative-hypothesis-h1-or-ha 3, u-formulating-correct-hypotheses 2, 7.3 1, u-test-statistics 5, u-critical-region 2, u-significance-level 3, u-p-value-and-its-importance 3, 7.4 1, u-steps-in-hypothesis-testing 2, u-simple-hypothesis-testing-examples 1, u-advanced-tests-f-test-and-chi-square-test 4, 7.5 1, u-importance-of-data-visualization 2, u-graphs-and-charts-for-presenting-results 3, u-linking-data-visuals-with-hypotheses 2, 7.6 2, u-bias-in-data-collection-and-analysis 4, u-ethical-use-of-data-and-models 2, u-responsible-communication-of-findings 2, 7.7 1, u-interpreting-test-results 2, u-connecting-conclusions-to-hypotheses 2, u-presenting-findings-clearly 2, u-summary 3.

Covers every topic in book order; every 'difference' question is answered as a two-column table; none repeats the chapter exercise (what is a hypothesis / research question / test statistic / p-value / critical region, defining H0, the basic steps, why visualization and ethical use matter and bias in data collection are left to the exercise). Small numericals use changed values and were computed in Python. Book corrections followed: chi-square is the Greek chi (χ²), the worked t-test's p-value is one-tailed (about 0.000012), alpha and H0/H1/Ha written as symbols.
Every question carries a book_ref (topic id and exact words of that topic's English lesson), verified by tools.py.
The Roman Urdu file has the same checkpoints, order and book_refs; each prompt keeps the English question with the Roman Urdu meaning in brackets.
Drafts for the academic review (second-person review before publication).
